headline: President Shahabuddin calls possible resignation 'embarrassing' question
summary: The President did not deny or refute reports of his potential resignation in a WhatsApp interview, while dismissing claims of contact with ousted PM Sheikh Hasina.
details: President Mohammed Shahabuddin did not deny or refute reports of his possible resignation during a WhatsApp interview with The Daily Star, calling the question 'embarrassing'.
When asked directly if he planned to step down, the President responded, 'You will see,' leaving the possibility open without a definitive confirmation or denial.
He strongly rejected claims that two ministers had recently met him, calling such reports 'false' and 'lies'.
The President also dismissed reports of a phone conversation with ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as 'baseless' and 'concocted', stating he was undergoing medical treatment in London at the time.
Regarding the whereabouts of the Speaker of Jatiya Sangsad, President Shahabuddin stated he was not supposed to be aware of the Speaker's location.

The Home Minister has stated there is no government move over the President's possible resignation, though he acknowledged that the President has the constitutional opportunity to resign if he wishes.
caption:
Is the President stepping down? Mohammed Shahabuddin calls the question 'embarrassing' and says, 'You will see.'

President Mohammed Shahabuddin did not deny or refute reports of his possible resignation during a WhatsApp interview with The Daily Star, calling the question 'embarrassing'.

When asked directly if he planned to step down, the President responded, 'You will see,' leaving the possibility open without a definitive confirmation or denial.

He strongly rejected claims that two ministers had recently met him, calling such reports 'false' and 'lies'.

The President also dismissed reports of a phone conversation with ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as 'baseless' and 'concocted', stating he was undergoing medical treatment in London at the time.

Regarding the whereabouts of the Speaker of Jatiya Sangsad, President Shahabuddin stated he was not supposed to be aware of the Speaker's location.

The Home Minister has stated there is no government move over the President's possible resignation, though he acknowledged that the President has the constitutional opportunity to resign if he wishes.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

headline: Pakistani singer Atif Aslam lands in Dhaka for major concert
summary: The singer arrived on July 22 and held his first-ever press conference in Bangladesh to interact with local media ahead of his upcoming show.
details: Pakistani singer Atif Aslam has arrived in Dhaka, putting an end to days of speculation regarding his much-anticipated concert.
The artiste landed in the capital on July 22 and attended his first-ever press conference in Bangladesh to interact with local media.
The concert, titled 'Shah Cement Presents Main Stage Show Featuring Atif Aslam', is organized by Main Stage and presented by Shah Cement.
The event will take place on July 24 at Purbachal Expressway, 300 ft in Dhaka.
Gates will open at 1:00 PM, with the show scheduled to begin at 5:00 PM.
The concert is expected to draw thousands of fans, making it one of the most anticipated live music events in Bangladesh this year.
caption:
Atif Aslam is finally here! The Pakistani superstar arrives in Dhaka for one of the year's most anticipated concerts.

Pakistani singer Atif Aslam has arrived in Dhaka, putting an end to days of speculation regarding his much-anticipated concert.

The artiste landed in the capital on July 22 and attended his first-ever press conference in Bangladesh to interact with local media.

The concert, titled 'Shah Cement Presents Main Stage Show Featuring Atif Aslam', is organized by Main Stage and presented by Shah Cement.

The event will take place on July 24 at Purbachal Expressway, 300 ft in Dhaka.

Gates will open at 1:00 PM, with the show scheduled to begin at 5:00 PM.

The concert is expected to draw thousands of fans, making it one of the most anticipated live music events in Bangladesh this year.
